summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on 2026-11-05/06 under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose daily ASX repurchase-program reporting, attaching ASX notices as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. The company reiterates its authorization to buy back up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock, with no specific transaction, price, share count, premium, or timeline stated in the excerpt. No board recommendation, advisor, regulatory clock, or structural overhang terms appear; the filing is purely routine program disclosure, with forward-looking language disclaiming any repurchase obligation. Watch only cumulative buyback pace versus the $1 billion authorization, not a special-situation catalyst.
